description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US（默认值）：英文。
description.en:
The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 健康探测模板ID，唯一标识健康探测模板。
description.en: The ID of the health check template. This ID uniquely identifies a health check template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns delete-cloud-gtm-monitor-template --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --template-id mtp-895180524251000000 --region cn-hangzhou
